name: folio-pdf-mcp
description: Headless MCP stdio bridge for Folio PDF — run its PyMuPDF engine (merge, split, redact, OCR, convert, and more) on local PDF files from Hermes, Claude Code, Codex, or any MCP client, no GUI required.
author: Mohamed Hatem (https://github.com/mhatem5351); based on work by Sam Wasserman (https://wassermanproductions.com)
